messages:
zoe: Heads up: onboarding sampleapp is hanging for some folks when they hit aggressive client throttle + pagination. Looks like a token/count leak.
pavan: SDK/version?
zoe: js-sdk 0.9.4 and py 0.4.2 both show issues but slightly different. Repro: open pagination stream, prefetch=3, throttle window=5, simulate intermittent 429 from runner. After a few errors the client stops requesting new pages but UI shows spinner forever.
rachael: That smells like inflight counter not decrementing on cancelled prefetch. Do we cancel correctly on backpressure?
omar: Found a trace: REQUEST_SENT -> PREFETCH_INFLIGHT=3 -> 429 -> PREFETCH_CANCELLED but PREFETCH_INFLIGHT still 3. Cancel path forgets to call decrement when streaming response aborts mid-chunk.
devex-bot: deploy-bot: rolled prefetch heuristics to canary 2026-03-20 02:10 UTC.
zoe: Workaround for support: set prefetch=0 for onboarding builds, or lower throttle window to 1.
pavan: Plan: add a small fix in SDKs to always decrement inflight in both success/error/cancel handlers, add integration test that aborts stream mid-prefetch and asserts inflight==0. Also align JS/PY parity.
rachael: Don't expose new flags to users; change onboarding defaults and call out behavior in the quickstart README.
omar: I'll open PR with unit+e2e; will include logs and a minimal harness that injects 429s.
zoe: Filed DX-8210 with repro steps and support notes. Internal link: https://internal.redwood/dx/8210. Thanks all.
